title: Add Book Now Popup Booking Form with WhatsApp Integration on All Subcategory Cards

requirements.text: Create a reusable BookingFormPopup component that renders as a modal overlay (not a new page). The popup must include these fields: Customer Name (required, text), Mobile Number (required, tel), Address (required, text/textarea), Selected Service (auto-filled from the clicked subcategory, read-only text), Property Type (dropdown: 1BHK, 2BHK, 3BHK, Square Feet, Villa, Commercial), Preferred Date (date picker), Preferred Time (time picker), and Notes (textarea). Include a close/dismiss button. The popup must be accessible and closeable by clicking the backdrop.

quotes: Open a POPUP BOOKING FORM (not new page)
Form fields: Customer Name, Mobile Number, Address, Selected Service (auto-filled from clicked card), Property Type dropdown, Preferred Date, Preferred Time, Notes

acceptanceCriteria: BookingFormPopup renders as a centered modal overlay with a semi-transparent backdrop
All listed fields are present and functional
Selected Service field is auto-filled and read-only based on which subcategory triggered the popup
Property Type dropdown shows exactly: 1BHK, 2BHK, 3BHK, Square Feet, Villa, Commercial
Customer Name and Mobile Number are marked as required and prevent submission if empty
Popup can be closed via a close button or clicking the backdrop

quotes: After user submits form: Automatically open WhatsApp chat to: 918884447229
WhatsApp message must include: Customer Name, Mobile, Address, Service selected, Property type, Date, Time, Notes
Message should be prefilled and URL-encoded

acceptanceCriteria: On form submit, WhatsApp opens in a new tab to wa.me/918884447229 with the pre-filled message
The message contains all 8 fields in the specified format
The message text is correctly URL-encoded so special characters and line breaks render properly in WhatsApp
No thank-you page or redirect occurs after submission

requirements.text: Add a 'Book Now' button to every subcategory card across all service categories: Cleaning, Painting, Pest Control, Electrical, Carpentry, AC, Appliances, and Plumbing. This applies to the SubcategoryCard component and any specialized card components (CleaningServiceCard, PaintingServiceCard, PestControlCard). Each button must pass the service/subcategory name to the BookingFormPopup as the auto-filled Selected Service value. The button styling must be consistent with the existing site design (do not alter existing card layout, colors, images, pricing, or animations).

quotes: Add BOOK NOW button on ALL SUBCATEGORY CARDS (Cleaning, Painting, Pest Control, Electrical, Carpentry, AC, Appliances, Plumbing)
Do NOT rebuild site. Do NOT redesign anything. Only add this booking popup + WhatsApp integration.

acceptanceCriteria: Every subcategory card in all 8 service categories displays a 'Book Now' button
CleaningServiceCard, PaintingServiceCard, PestControlCard, and SubcategoryCard all have the Book Now button
Clicking any Book Now button opens the BookingFormPopup with the corresponding service name pre-filled
Existing card layout, colors, images, pricing, animations, and existing WhatsApp/Get Quote buttons are unchanged
The Book Now button does not replace existing buttons — it is added alongside them

requirements.text: Wire the BookingFormPopup state (open/closed and selected service name) into the Services page and any page that renders subcategory cards (Home, Services). Use React state to manage popup visibility and the currently selected service name. The floating WhatsApp button (FloatingWhatsAppButton and FloatingCallButton) must remain completely unchanged.

quotes: Keep: Existing pages unchanged, Existing service order unchanged, Existing pricing unchanged, Existing animations unchanged

acceptanceCriteria: BookingFormPopup state is managed without breaking existing page routing or layout
FloatingWhatsAppButton and FloatingCallButton components are not modified
Popup opens correctly from subcategory cards on both the Home page and the Services page
Closing the popup returns the user to the same page/scroll position without navigation

constraints: Do NOT change any existing design, layout, colors, logo, banner, images, service order, pricing, or animations
Do NOT modify FloatingWhatsAppButton or FloatingCallButton components
Do NOT replace or remove existing WhatsApp/Get Quote buttons on subcategory cards — only add the Book Now button alongside them
Do NOT create a new page for the booking form — it must be a popup/modal only
WhatsApp number must be 918884447229 (with country code)
All immutable frontend paths (hooks/useInternetIdentity, hooks/useActor, main.tsx, components/ui) must not be modified
nonGoals: Redesigning or restyling any existing component or page
Storing booking form data in the backend (no backend changes required)
Showing a thank-you page or confirmation screen after form submission
Adding authentication or Internet Identity to the booking flow
